description.value: Med Grill occupies a 100-year-old heritage building — the former Saanich Municipal Hall — in Royal Oak, just minutes from Downtown Victoria. Head chef Andrew Johnson crafts seasonal Mediterranean-inspired menus with west coast flair, served in a candlelit interior with a cozy fireplace or on a spacious wrap-around patio. The restaurant has been a local Victoria favourite since 1997 and features a rotating Tuscan Table three-course dinner alongside a rotating monthly menu.
